edits.headline: Christa Pike in critical condition after failed Tennessee execution
edits.subheadline: Tennessee officials gave her two doses of pentobarbital on 30 September but could not complete the execution, Al Jazeera reported.
editorialBody: Christa Pike is in critical condition in hospital after Tennessee failed to execute her on 30 September, her lawyer said, BBC News reported on 2 October.
Her lawyers said she was given two doses of pentobarbital, Al Jazeera reported. Governor Bill Lee ordered a third-party review.
A former police chief said the botched lethal injection took the focus off Pike's victim and put her execution in jeopardy, Fox News reported.

Anwar Gargash, diplomatic adviser to the UAE president, called the 30 September attack on flydubai flight FZ1073 a "dangerous terrorist act", Khaleej Times reported. He praised the Indian captain, Smit Machchhar.

Funding cuts threaten the education of refugee children, UNHCR said in a report covered by UN News. About 5.8 million of 13.1 million school-age refugee children were out of school in 2025, the agency said.
Diesel prices fell sharply as the EU considered releasing 50mn barrels under pressure from US President Donald Trump, the Financial Times reported.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi faces pressure from a "cockroach" movement and from opposition parties, the South China Morning Post reported.
